name: Rise | 200mg Tablets 1:1:1 | PM THC:CBD:CBN
description:
NEW! RISE PM Tablets are formulated with equal parts of THC, CBD, and CBN to help give that night time wind-down experience! Established out of a desire to improve patient well-being, RISE products provide a robust custom cannabis platform. Each tablet contains 10mg total cannabinoids and natural terpenes. RISE products are also free of sugar, gluten, and nuts.

PM Tablets - 10MG per tablet. 20 tablets/bottle

Custom ratios. Custom doses. Custom cannabis.
